parameters.objective: maximum squared pair distance divided by minimum squared pair distance

best_human.source_location: n=12 row and mm12.gif diagram; source reports r^2=5+2*sqrt(3) and credits Ingo Rechenberg (2006)
best_human.provenance: Independent exact reconstruction of the pictured geometry; substitute a 63-digit rational lower approximation to sqrt(3) for a rational witness. The page supplies the diagram and value, not coordinate strings.
best_human.ai_provenance: The source credits Ingo Rechenberg (2006); no AI provenance is reported.
best_human.reference_rounding: human_reference is the positive JSON number 8.464101615137755, rounded upward from the exact rational reconstruction for the frozen compatibility score.
best_human.evidence_state: All 66 squared distances were recomputed exactly. The rational substitution has minimum squared distance below 1 and an exact ratio slightly above 5+2*sqrt(3).

best_public.source_location: Current n=12 row; credited to Rechenberg, 2006
best_public.provenance: Public page reports the exact squared ratio and image. The local rational witness is an independent reconstruction and is not presented as the original coordinate file.
best_public.ai_provenance: No AI provenance is reported by the source.
best_public.evidence_state: Published feasible upper bound; the local rational witness has a slightly weaker exact score. Optimality remains open.

best_reproduced.provenance: Rational reconstruction from the 12-point published diagram, with sqrt(3) replaced by floor(sqrt(3)*10^63)/10^63.
best_reproduced.ai_provenance: Human-source construction reconstructed locally; no AI attribution applies to the 2006 report.
best_reproduced.evidence_state: The exact rational checker verifies 12 distinct points and all 66 squared distances.

frozen_human_baseline.provenance: Exact rational reconstruction of the public n=12 diagram; H is rounded upward to a JSON number.

highest_reported.metric: maximum squared pair distance divided by minimum squared pair distance for 12 planar points
highest_reported.source_location: Current n=12 entry; Rechenberg construction from 2006
highest_reported.reproduction_status: Exact Q(sqrt(3)) geometry gives 5+2*sqrt(3). The frozen rational point list substitutes a lower 63-digit approximation to sqrt(3), so its exact score is reported separately and is slightly worse.

optimality_status.state: open; the 2025 AlphaEvolve paper says exact values are listed through n=8 and calls n=9..30 numerical candidates
